diagnosis.what_happened: Agents created .stale copies but left original validation files, and semPlot diagram edge labels were oversized (cex=1.3) causing text crowding.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Ghost validation files stalled the pipeline recursively, and high-res semPaths plots were visually unreadable due to overlapping edge labels.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Physical deletion of old validation files (unlinking), and edge.label.cex calibrated to 0.80 for 4500x2400 canvases.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Recursive file watchers require exact current state representation without legacy residue. High DPI canvases require downscaled label vectors to prevent collision.

desired_behavior: Always delete original files when archiving to .stale. Explicitly set edge.label.cex = 0.80 (range 0.75-0.85) in semPaths for high-res high-DPI outputs.
generalization: Artifact lifecycle requires hard unlinking of legacy states. R plotting aesthetics must scale inversely with high canvas resolutions.

evidence.observed_value: Validation loop failed continuously; text crowded on plot
evidence.threshold_value: Zero residual legacy files; readable plot text
